card.name: First piece of a drug name after 'with'
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug brand or generic name split into parts, usually right after 'treated with', 'treatment with', 'use with' or 'administration of' (e.g. O in ONGENTYS, def in deferasirox). Weaker on odd starts such as '(' or '.' inside dose figures.
